== Summary ==
Slip “•Yoda’s Hope” cut unchanged from page 8 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 1153, 581, 1437)). Version [[Yoda's Hope (V)#Source formats|Yoda's Hope (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
